thread:
mira: Heads-up — SRE wants better attribution for automatic fallback events. Console just shows 'fallback' and it's impossible to trace to the policy or trigger.

dave: +1. Saw a pager where fallback_owner was empty and we had to manually correlate logs.

kevin: Quick question: what are the minimal attributes we need to ship? decision_id, policy_name, trigger_reason, model_variant?

mira: I think decision_id, policy_name, policy_version, trigger_code, model_from, model_to, sampling_rate. Also a short human 'why' string.

sofia: Important: show explicit error trigger (503, timeout, rate-limit, model-oom) not just "error". Otherwise engineers guess.

mira: UX constraint: avoid cluttering the primary route table. Maybe show a compact "why" and allow expand -> full payload.

kevin: Debate: should the fallback info be returned to clients as a response header (eg. X-Rw-Fallback) or only emitted to telemetry/eventstore? Ops likes header for quick debugging. Product worries about surface area.

dave: Header useful for curl/debugging. Telemetry-only means customers don't get immediate context when they see degraded results. If header, redact any PII.

ops-bot: :information_source: deploy-notice: feature-flag "fallback-decision-header" scheduled for staging rollout 2026-03-25T08:00Z.

sofia: UX ask: console should expose "fallback breadcrumbs" per rollout with filters by policy/version and target model_variant. Also link to eventstore for deep-dive.

mira: Concrete proposal: add X-Rw-Fallback header with compressed fields: decision_id,policy=NAME,trigger=CODE,from=MODEL,to=MODEL. Full JSON payload (all fields + raw reason) goes to eventstore and is clickable from console row.

kevin: Implementation note: decision_id needs to be deterministic and idempotent for request retries. Suggest UUIDv7 or hash(request_id + policy_version + timestamp_bucket).

dave: Also add a small audit link in console row that opens eventstore/?decision_id=... so ops can jump straight to logs. No free-text blobs in UI.

mira: I'll draft a short RFC with example header, telemetry schema, and console mockups. Reviewers: @kevin @dave @sofia.

sofia: I'll review. Tests: ensure header emitted only when flag ON and never included in responses marked PII or when customer opted out.

mira: Great. I'll aim to post RFC in #eng-platform tomorrow morning and include a minimal e2e test harness.

kevin: Thanks — also flagging for eng-ml review since model-switch propagation needs kernel-level hooks.

mira: Noted. I'll ping @eng-ml in RFC.
